name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 31 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2026-06-20, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
